findings.passage: Extreme risk protection orders and background checks are common sense, proven policies to address gun violence while still respecting due process and 2nd amendment rights.
findings.note: Her own press release dated November 7, 2019, issued after Assembly leaders turned down the governor's call for a special session on universal background checks on all firearm purchases and extreme risk protection orders. In the same release she says state government has a role in keeping people safe from gun violence.
